results.name: 01_setup
results.prompt: Build me Space Invaders, 2D, classic 1980s arcade style. Black background, 768x720 canvas. A green pixelated player ship at the bottom that moves left/right with arrow keys. Use vanilla JavaScript and canvas only, single HTML file. No external libraries.

results.name: 02_enemies
results.prompt: Add a grid of 5 rows x 11 columns of green pixelated enemy aliens at the top. They should move left and right as a group, dropping down one row when hitting the edge, getting faster as fewer remain.
results.responseText: Replaced the intro with a 5×11 grid of green pixelated invaders. The formation steps horizontally on a fixed timer, alternates between two sprite frames, and drops one row + reverses on edge contact.

results.name: 03_shooting
results.prompt: Spacebar shoots a white bullet from the player ship upward. Bullets that hit enemies destroy them. Add a score counter that increments when an enemy is destroyed.
results.responseText: Added a white player ship at the bottom, spacebar firing with cooldown, upward-moving bullets that destroy aliens on AABB collision, and a SCORE counter in the HUD that increments by 10 per kill. All

results.name: 04_enemy_fire
results.prompt: Enemies occasionally shoot bullets back down at the player. If an enemy bullet hits the player, the player loses a life. Start with 3 lives. Show lives in the UI.
results.responseText:
Added enemy bullets and a lives system:

- New CFG entries for enemy bullet speed/interval/color, starting lives (3), and respawn invulnerability
- `fireEnemyBullet()` picks a random frontmost alien p

results.name: 05_game_states
results.prompt: Add game over screen when lives reach 0. Add win screen when all enemies destroyed. Both screens show the final score and 'Press SPACE to restart'.
results.responseText:
I'll add a win state, restart logic, and update the end screens to show score + restart prompt.Now add win detection after kill and update the render to draw both screens.Changes:
- Added `won` state

results.name: 06_juice
results.prompt: Add juice: screen shake when player is hit, particles when enemies explode, simple bleep/boop sound effects with Web Audio API (no external audio files). Make it feel alive.
results.responseText: Adding juice: Web Audio system, particle bursts, and camera shake wired through the existing EventBus.Now wrap the world draw in a shake transform and draw particles inside it. UI stays unshaken.Added
